full_judgment: 29. We have again placed the pleadings a bit detail before us. On the pleadings, one fact is admitted by the defendants that the plaintiffs are in possession of the suit land at least since 1956, according to defendants. But there is not an iota of evidence on record to show anybody else possessed the suit land from prior to 1956 up to 1927 save and except Habu Khalifa. Presumption, if any, arising out of RS record of rights and SA record of rights prepared on the previous record was washed away by long, open and overt continuous possession of Habu Khalifa. Trial Court could not find any evidence oral or documentary whatsoever on record to support such record of rights, we find correctly. It has accordingly, held that those record of rights were wrong.
